name: com.foreverworks/home-assistant
title: Home Assistant
description: Read your Home Assistant's states, areas and history, and run its actions, approving locks first.

environmentVariables.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: The address you open Home Assistant at, such as http://homeassistant.local:8123.

environmentVariables.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding a long-lived access token made in an administrator's Home Assistant profile.

environmentVariables.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_CONFIRM_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Action domains you approve call by call, comma-separated (default lock,alarm_control_panel,cover,valve; none for none).
